recommendations.recommendation: Define what you want and fear, and set goals to build a lifestyle you actually want instead of postponing life to retirement.
recommendations.rationale: Deferring enjoyment to retirement is wasteful, and time and mobility are the true wealth.
recommendations.argued_against: Deferred life plan and the traditional retirement model

recommendations.recommendation: Ask yourself the worst that could happen when you fear a bold move, and see that it is usually recoverable.
recommendations.rationale: Fear-setting shows that risks are smaller than imagined and that inaction has a bigger cost.

recommendations.recommendation: Apply the 80/20 rule: find the few tasks and customers that produce most results and drop the rest.
recommendations.rationale: A small share of efforts yields most outcomes.

recommendations.recommendation: Limit work to the essentials, setting tight deadlines and low-information routines.
recommendations.rationale: Work expands to fill available time, so constraints force focus.
recommendations.argued_against: Being busy as a status symbol

recommendations.recommendation: Practice a low-information diet: avoid news and unnecessary email.
recommendations.rationale: Most information is irrelevant and distracts from action.

recommendations.recommendation: Eliminate before automating: remove tasks, then delegate and automate what remains.
recommendations.rationale: Doing less matters more than doing things faster.

recommendations.recommendation: Outsource tasks to remote assistants and write clear instructions so others can do them.
recommendations.rationale: It frees your time and lets you focus on high-value actions.

recommendations.recommendation: Create a simple product that serves a niche, test demand cheaply, and automate sales.
recommendations.rationale: Small automated businesses produce income independent of your time.

recommendations.recommendation: Negotiate remote work with your employer by proving productivity first.
recommendations.rationale: Showing results lets you ask for freedom from the office; if refused, you can leave.

recommendations.recommendation: Take mini-retirements: extended periods of travel and living abroad throughout life.
recommendations.rationale: Spreading time off through life is better than one retirement; living abroad can be cheap with income in a stronger currency.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not wait for the perfect time; take action and improve as you go.
recommendations.rationale: Waiting is the usual source of failure.

recommendations.recommendation: Fill the time you free up with learning, experiences, and service, not more work.
recommendations.rationale: Free time without purpose causes boredom, so use it for things that make life interesting.
